## Description

Provide a clear summary of the changes in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)

- [ ] 📚 Topic challenge addition (`data/challenges.ts`)

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] All unit and journey tests pass: `npm test`
- [ ] TypeScript typecheck passes with 0 errors: `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Linter passes: `npm run lint`
- [ ] Production build succeeds: `npm run build`
- [ ] Follows existing project conventions and UI guidelines
